title: Hang sâu yên tĩnh
about: Round x10, for sleep with improvised melodies (style ngu-ngon), as the user asked to go on ("ok chúng ta hãy tiếp tục sáng tác nhạc"), on the sounds the user liked most: a quiet cavern: a drop now and then far off, a singing bowl, the dark pad, the glass improvising softly in the echo. E Dorian. No drums, plucked string or organ. An original piece; its melody made up by the improviser in dark/ambient.py.
